_metadata._description: Combat Lab test ship: Test_Target_EmissiveArmor - Stationary target with EmissiveArmor(5) reducing each hit by 5 damage

name: Test Target Emissive Armor
_test_notes: Target with EmissiveArmor(5). Each incoming hit is reduced by 5 damage. Beam weapons dealing 1 damage per hit will be completely blocked. Beam weapons dealing 5+ damage per hit will be partially reduced. Mass=400 from hull_test_s only.
